name: Hollow Mimic
summary: A gaunt thing with a hollow face that hunts in the dark by sounding like people you know.

sections.title: Rank and Class
sections.text: Usually an Awakened Demon: three soul cores, three shards. Demons fight with real tactics and go for whoever is weakest.

sections.title: Habits
sections.text: While it stands in darkness and nobody looks at it, it speaks in chat with the name of a player it has heard, from where it waits. Its words never pause: its lines have no punctuation at all.

sections.title: Weakness
sections.text: Bright light weakens and silences it. It will not close in on someone with a companion nearby unless struck. Agree a phrase with friends to tell them from it.

sections.title: Drops
sections.text: Mimic Husk (one or two) for the Hollow Visage and Hollow Edge, and its soul shards.
